<thought>Based on the observed mass (m/z ≈ 233.96, indicating one chlorine atom) and the 13C NMR data (six aromatic carbons and three aliphatic carbons at ~49, 26, 11 ppm), the most plausible structure is a chlorophenyl group attached to a short aliphatic chain containing an ether/alcohol functionality. A reasonable SMILES that fits these features is “Clc1ccc(cc1)CCCO”.</thought>
<final_answer>Clc1ccc(cc1)CCCO</final_answer>
